chunks: And indeed the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said to some of his wives:
"Tell the believing women to perform istinja with water and to be thorough, for it is a purification for the surrounding parts and a remover of hemorrhoids."

key_terms.بِٱلْمَاءِ: with water, the means of cleansing mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.مَطْهَرَةٌ: a means of purification and cleanliness
key_terms.يَسْتَنْجِينَ: to perform istinja, cleansing oneself after relieving oneself
key_terms.يُبَالِغْنَ: to be thorough and diligent in the cleansing
key_terms.ٱلنِّسَاءَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ: the believing women being addressed in the instruction
key_terms.ٱلْبَوَاسِيرِ: hemorrhoids, whose removal or prevention is mentioned
key_terms.ٱلْحَوَاشِي: the surrounding private areas being cleansed

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about using water for istinja?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believing women to use water for istinja and to do so thoroughly. It presents this practice as both a means of taharah and a source of bodily benefit.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.62 - The Prophet, said to some of his wives:
"Tell the believing women to perform istinja with water and to be thorough in it, for it is a means of purification for the private parts and helps prevent hemorrhoids."
